findings.description: CacheKey type as u64 for identifying extents
findings.notes: CacheKey re-exported from interfaces crate

findings.description: Location enum should have Staging, BlockDevice, and MemoryTier variants. Implementation only has BlockDevice and MemoryTier.
findings.notes: Staging variant and Arc<DmaBuffer> entirely removed. Entry struct otherwise matches: size_blocks u32, read_ref u32, write_ref u32, EvictionHandle, Mutex/Condvar.

findings.description: create_staging(key, size) allocates DMA buffer, records entry with write_ref=1, error on size=0 or alloc failure
findings.notes: Method does not exist. Staging concept replaced by create_memory_tier_entry which accepts pre-allocated pointer. Intentional architectural removal.

findings.description: lookup returns NotExist/Staging/BlockDevice/MemoryTier, increments read_ref, blocks on write with 2000ms timeout, refreshes TSC
findings.notes: Staging variant absent from LookupResult. Returns NotExist/BlockDevice/MemoryTier only. All other behaviors (read_ref increment, blocking on write_ref with 2000ms timeout, TSC refresh via eviction policy) correctly implemented.

findings.description: convert_to_storage transitions Staging->BlockDevice, sets ssd_offset on MemoryTier, conditional read_ref decrement
findings.notes: No Staging variant to transition from. Only handles MemoryTier (sets ssd_offset) and rejects BlockDevice. Conditional read_ref decrement when read_ref>0 is correct. Error on already-BlockDevice is correct.

findings.description: take_read waits until write_ref=0 with 2000ms timeout, then increments read_ref
findings.notes: Uses wait_for with DEFAULT_TIMEOUT (2000ms); returns Timeout on failure

findings.description: take_write waits until read_ref=0 and write_ref=0 with 2000ms timeout
findings.notes: Uses wait_for with DEFAULT_TIMEOUT; sets write_ref=1 on success

findings.description: release_read decrements read_ref, error on underflow
findings.notes: Returns RefCountUnderflow if read_ref already 0; notifies condvar on success

findings.description: release_write decrements write_ref, error on underflow
findings.notes: Returns RefCountUnderflow if write_ref already 0; sets write_ref=0; notifies condvar

findings.description: downgrade_reference atomically transitions write to read reference
findings.notes: write_ref=0, read_ref+=1 in single critical section; error if no write ref held; notifies condvar

findings.description: remove deletes entry, error if active references
findings.notes: Checks read_ref>0 || write_ref>0; also removes from eviction policy

findings.description: IEvictionPolicy must be connected (error if unbound); recovers from IExtentManager via for_each_extent; Ok(()) if no IExtentManager bound
findings.notes: Returns NotInitialized error if eviction_policy unconnected; populates map with BlockDevice entries from extent manager

findings.description: All methods thread-safe and re-entrant
findings.notes: All state behind Mutex<Inner>; Condvar for blocking; no unsafe concurrent access

findings.description: ILogger receptacle used for info, debug, and error logging
findings.notes: Logger used in initialize, lookup, convert_to_storage, take_read, take_write, release_read, release_write, downgrade_reference, remove, create_memory_tier_entry, convert_memory_tier_to_block

findings.description: define_component! with IDispatchMap provider, ILogger/IExtentManager/IEvictionPolicy receptacles
findings.notes: Correct macro usage with version 0.2.0, provides [IDispatchMap], receptacles for logger, extent_manager, eviction_policy

findings.description: touch(key) marks entry as most-recently-used via IEvictionPolicy, no references acquired, KeyNotFound if missing
findings.notes: Gets eviction_handle from entry, calls ep.touch(handle); no ref count modification

findings.description: oldest_keys(n) delegates to IEvictionPolicy::peek_oldest(pool, n), thread-safe
findings.notes: Gets pool_id, calls ep.peek_oldest(pool_id, n); returns Vec<CacheKey>

findings.description: MemoryTier variant with pointer/size/ssd_offset; create_memory_tier_entry(key, pointer, size) and convert_memory_tier_to_block(key)
findings.notes: create_memory_tier_entry creates with write_ref=1, rejects size=0 and duplicates. convert_memory_tier_to_block reads offset from ssd_offset field. Spec says offset is 'read from the entry's internal ssd_offset field rather than passed as a parameter' which matches implementation.

findings.description: set_dma_alloc(alloc) for injecting DMA allocator used by create_staging
findings.notes: Method does not exist. create_staging was removed; create_memory_tier_entry accepts pre-allocated pointer so DMA alloc injection is unnecessary. Intentional architectural removal.

findings.description: initialize() is explicit public API, not implicitly called during construction
findings.notes: Must be called explicitly after binding receptacles

findings.description: convert_to_storage on MemoryTier sets ssd_offset rather than transitioning to BlockDevice
findings.notes: Match arm for Location::MemoryTier sets *ssd_offset = Some(offset)

findings.description: is_evictable(key) returns true iff MemoryTier with ssd_offset:Some and no active refs
findings.notes: Checks read_ref==0, write_ref==0, Location::MemoryTier{ssd_offset: Some(_)}; returns false for non-existent, non-MemoryTier, no ssd_offset, or active refs

findings.description: entry_size(key) returns size_blocks * 4096 without acquiring references, KeyNotFound on missing key
findings.notes: Returns stored size in block-aligned bytes; no ref count changes

findings.description: All committed extents recoverable from persistent storage on initialization
findings.notes: for_each_extent iterates all extents and inserts them into the map

findings.description: Concurrent readers experience no data corruption or deadlocks
findings.notes: Mutex serializes all entry access; Condvar provides blocking semantics without busy-waiting

findings.description: Write-to-read downgrade completes atomically with no unprotected window
findings.notes: Both write_ref=0 and read_ref+=1 happen inside single lock acquisition

findings.description: DispatchEntry struct size varies by Location variant (Staging includes Arc<DmaBuffer>)
findings.notes: Staging variant no longer exists. Entry size now varies between BlockDevice (offset: u64) and MemoryTier (pointer + size + ssd_offset). The reference to Arc<DmaBuffer> is obsolete.

findings.description: Lookup completes without blocking when no writer is active
findings.notes: wait_for predicate satisfied immediately when write_ref==0

findings.description: All ref count operations maintain consistent counts, no leaks or underflows
findings.notes: Underflow checks on release; checked_add on increment; atomic downgrade

unspecced.feature: recover_extent(key, offset, size_blocks) — directly inserts BlockDevice entry with eviction tracking
unspecced.notes: Present in IDispatchMap interface (interfaces/src/idispatch_map.rs:237-243). Used for incremental recovery bypassing initialize(). Returns AlreadyExists if key present.

unspecced.feature: entry_size() module-level free function — returns sizeof(DispatchEntry)
unspecced.notes: Benchmark/assertion utility; distinct from FR-023 entry_size(key) instance method
